scope: Independent Standards and Spec reviews plus two ignored assembled OrgExplorerClient reproductions. No source changes by merger.

standards.finding: Refresh invalidates a pending selected-person request, reloads only already-present people and clears failures. If the selected object remains undefined, URL load dependencies do not change, leaving Loading person without recovery.
standards.standard: docs/refs/ux-language.md loading/error recovery and refresh contract

spec.finding: Held selected-person read followed by shared Refresh never settles after the old response is discarded.
spec.spec: 1724.md capability inventory: selected/deep-link failed loads gain explicit retry; refresh preserves previous shown people and invalidates stale responses.
spec.reproduction: partial roster excludes deb; open ?employee=deb; hold people read; refresh returns partial base roster; complete old people read successfully; actual sheet remains Loading person; expected Deb detail or usable retry

spec.finding: failedLoads stores readPeople's generation-capturing closure. React Activity cleanup increments generation but preserves failedLoads. Retry executes the old inner generation, ignores successful data and outer settleRead clears the failure.
spec.spec: 1724.md large organization capability: retained partial-data notice and retry after failure.
spec.reproduction: expand missing deb branch; action fails; Activity hidden then visible; retry action succeeds; actual Deb remains absent and recovery disappears
